title: Men's Shorts 3-Pack – Quick-Dry Workout Shorts
descriptionHtml:
Three pairs of comfy shorts – in one purchase

Good workout shorts run out in the closet faster than you'd think. Searching for clean, dry shorts every morning is both a waste of time and stressful.

Lightweight and quick-drying

These shorts come in a 3-pack and are made from lightweight, breathable fabric. They dry quickly and have a practical zip pocket.

Features

  • 3 pairs in one purchase
  • Lightweight, breathable fabric
  • Quick-drying
  • Practical zip pocket
  • Great for running, the gym and everyday wear

14 days to change your mind. Counted from the day you receive the item.
